title: Bartell d’Arcy
html_source:
Arthur Hanket as Bartell D'Arcy in The Dead.

Source: robnagle.com

anchor.prefix:
nnis? My memory is getting. Pen ...? of course it's years ago. Noise of the trams probably. Well, if he couldn't remember the dayfather's name that he sees every day. 

1922#148
anchor.suffix:
was the tenor, just coming out then. Seeing her home after practice. Conceited fellow with his waxedup moustache. Gave her that song Winds that blow from the south. 

 Windy night
